subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI channel viewing stop at the current Sessions-page Group by channel behavior, fold into the broader sessions workspace, or add a first-class separated/merged channel timeline toggle here?
rationale: Current main covers channel grouping, but a merged timeline and separated tab mode need UX, privacy, routing, and Gateway/session semantics that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and define separated view, merged timeline, privacy, and routing semantics before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining behavior under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one broader sessions workspace design to own channel views too.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide the current Group by channel table plus single-session chat links is the intended Control UI surface.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and define separated view, merged timeline, privacy, and routing semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the closest current-main session grouping work and recent session-first sidebar changes.
